confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attack (failed logins) to a successful unauthorized login from an external IP, followed by privilege escalation, cross-departmental data exfiltration, and log tampering to hide tracks.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual external IP (23.129.64.222) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the same external IP after multiple failures.
Privilege escalation: user_03 elevated their role to admin.
Data exfiltration: bulk download of files across multiple departments (Sales, Shared, Security) that are outside the user's normal HR directory.
Anti-forensics: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to conceal the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether the external IP (23.129.64.222) is associated with a known VPN or malicious actor.
Verification of whether user_03 was actually working or if their credentials were stolen.
narrative: An attacker successfully performed a brute-force attack against user_03's account from an external IP, gaining access during off-hours. Once inside, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, exfiltrated sensitive data from the Sales, Engineering, and Security departments, and finally deleted authentication logs to cover their tracks.
